meta.subject: update bit width of cdma2sc_dat_slice and sc2cdma_dat_slice from 12bits to 14bits

en.summary: This commit fixes CDMA slice-count truncation by widening slice-related counters and interfaces from 12 bits to 14 bits across producer blocks, status bookkeeping, and the CDMA-to-SC boundary.
why_it_counts: It modifies core CDMA RTL modules and the shared status interface, not tests or infrastructure.
The changed widths affect functional slice accounting across module boundaries.
The patch updates internal grain and slice counters together with the exported slice buses, showing a real end-to-end correctness fix.
evidence: NV_NVDLA_CDMA_dc.v widens req_cur_grain_w, req_cur_grain_d1/d2, rsp_slice_init/last, and dat_slices_d0 to 14 bits.
NV_NVDLA_CDMA_status.v widens dc2status/img2status/wg2status/sc2cdma/cdma2sc slice buses and the valid-slices bookkeeping path to 14 bits.
NV_NVDLA_CDMA_IMG_pack.v and NV_NVDLA_CDMA_wg.v update the producer-side slice outputs to 14 bits, and NV_NVDLA_cdma.v widens the top-level interfaces accordingly.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A DMA subsystem often tracks two related but different quantities: how many buffer entries were produced and how many slices or lines those entries correspond to. If the slice count is carried on a narrower bus than the largest supported transfer requires, different producers can report truncated slice totals to a shared status block and to downstream consumers. The result is inconsistent bookkeeping: entries may look correct while slice-based availability, pending-ack, or consumer progress decisions wrap or undercount.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A transfer generates more slices than the stale narrow slice-count interface or internal slice counters can represent.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Narrow the slice-count buses and internal slice/grain counters so high bits are dropped before status bookkeeping and downstream synchronization.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: truncate inter-module count bus and bookkeeping registers
portability_notes: Apply this to designs where a producer reports slice, row, or line counts separately from entry or beat counts.
The most portable target is the shared status or queue-availability path that aggregates counts from multiple producer pipelines.
Keep entry counters wide so the bug specifically manifests as slice-accounting corruption rather than total data-loss everywhere.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the slice-count outputs of the DMA producer blocks and the shared status block that accumulates them.
Reduce those slice buses to an older, narrower width and restore narrow zero-extension at producer outputs.
Reduce any internal grain or slice registers that feed the same status path so truncation happens before accumulation.
Leave entry-count buses unchanged so downstream logic observes an entry-versus-slice mismatch on large transfers.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CDMA producer slice outputs, status valid-slices accounting, and cdma2sc/sc2cdma slice interfaces
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix widens slice-related interfaces and internal bookkeeping from 12 bits to 14 bits across DC, IMG, WG, status, and the top-level CDMA-to-SC interface, while also widening internal grain-to-slice registers that feed those paths.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the slice buses in NV_NVDLA_CDMA_status.v, NV_NVDLA_cdma.v, NV_NVDLA_CDMA_img.v, NV_NVDLA_CDMA_wg.v, and NV_NVDLA_CDMA_IMG_pack.v to 12 bits, and narrow the related grain/slice registers in NV_NVDLA_CDMA_dc.v back to their old 12-bit forms.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Large transfers wrap or undercount slice totals, causing status valid-slices bookkeeping, pending coordination, or downstream consumer progress tracking to diverge from the actual data produced.
evidence_for_injection: The patch consistently widens both local slice/grain registers and the cross-module slice interfaces, indicating a real functional range mismatch.
The status block accumulates and subtracts slice counts, so truncation there can change availability decisions even if entries remain correct.
Producer modules explicitly zero-extend their slice outputs after the fix, which gives a direct reverse-mutation point.
notes: This is a good reusable bug record for systems with separate line or slice accounting alongside entry accounting.
The highest-value reverse mutation is often at the shared status interface, because it corrupts aggregation from multiple producers at once.

zh.summary: 该提交通过把切片相关计数器和接口从 12 位扩展到 14 位，修复了 CDMA 在 producer 模块、状态记账以及 CDMA 到 SC 边界上的 slice 计数截断问题。
why_it_counts: 它修改的是核心 CDMA RTL 模块和共享状态接口，而不是测试或基础设施。
这些位宽变化会影响跨模块传递的真实 slice 记账结果。
补丁同时更新了内部 grain/slice 计数器和导出的 slice 总线，说明这是端到端的正确性修复。
evidence: NV_NVDLA_CDMA_dc.v 把 req_cur_grain_w、req_cur_grain_d1/d2、rsp_slice_init/last 和 dat_slices_d0 等信号扩展到 14 位。
NV_NVDLA_CDMA_status.v 把 dc2status/img2status/wg2status/sc2cdma/cdma2sc 的 slice 总线及 valid-slices 记账路径统一扩展到 14 位。
NV_NVDLA_CDMA_IMG_pack.v 和 NV_NVDLA_CDMA_wg.v 更新了 producer 侧 slice 输出位宽，NV_NVDLA_cdma.v 也同步扩展了顶层接口。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: DMA 子系统通常会同时跟踪两个相关但不同的量：实际产生了多少 buffer entries，以及这些 entries 对应多少 slices 或行数。如果 slice 计数所经过的总线位宽小于最大支持传输所需范围，那么不同 producer 向共享状态块和下游消费者报告的 slice 总数就会被截断。结果会出现不一致的记账：entry 数看起来正确，但基于 slice 的可用量、pending 协调或消费者进度判断会回绕或低估。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 跨模块 slice 计数记账
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某次传输产生的 slice 数超过旧的窄 slice 接口或内部 slice 计数器能够表示的范围。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 缩窄 slice 计数总线以及内部 slice/grain 计数器，使高位在状态记账和下游同步之前被丢弃。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: truncate inter-module count bus and bookkeeping registers
portability_notes: 适用于 producer 会单独上报 slice、row 或 line 计数，而不是只上报 entry 或 beat 数的设计。
最可移植的目标是那个汇聚多个 producer 计数的共享状态或队列可用量路径。
应保持 entry 计数为宽位宽不变，这样故障会主要表现为 slice 记账损坏，而不是全路径数据都丢失。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位 DMA producer 输出 slice 计数的接口，以及聚合这些计数的共享状态块。
把这些 slice 总线缩回旧的窄位宽，并在 producer 输出端恢复较窄的零扩展。
把馈入同一路径的内部 grain 或 slice 寄存器也缩窄，使截断在累加前就发生。
保持 entry 计数总线不变，使下游在大传输下观察到 entry 与 slice 记账不一致。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CDMA producer 的 slice 输出、status valid-slices 记账，以及 cdma2sc/sc2cdma slice 接口
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 DC、IMG、WG、status 以及顶层 CDMA 到 SC 接口中的 slice 相关接口和内部记账从 12 位扩展到 14 位，同时扩展了给这些路径供数的内部 grain-to-slice 寄存器。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 NV_NVDLA_CDMA_status.v、NV_NVDLA_cdma.v、NV_NVDLA_CDMA_img.v、NV_NVDLA_CDMA_wg.v 和 NV_NVDLA_CDMA_IMG_pack.v 中的 slice 总线改回 12 位，并把 NV_NVDLA_CDMA_dc.v 中相关的 grain/slice 寄存器缩回旧的 12 位形式。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 大传输场景下 slice 总数会回绕或被低估，导致 status valid-slices 记账、pending 协调或下游消费者进度跟踪与真实产生的数据不一致。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁一致性地扩展了本地 slice/grain 寄存器和跨模块 slice 接口，说明真实问题是功能性的范围不匹配。
status 模块会对 slice 计数做加减累积，因此即使 entry 计数正确，那里发生截断也会改变可用量判断。
producer 模块在修复后显式做了更宽的零扩展，这提供了直接的逆向变异锚点。
notes: 这是一条很适合复用于“entry 记账正确但 line/slice 记账错误”的数据集记录。
通常最有价值的逆向注入点是共享状态接口，因为它会同时污染多个 producer 的聚合结果。
